title: A Lantern for the Harbor
author: H. M. Vane
blurb: Dominic Winterbourne, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
